title: Okay, but somewat cumbersome and horrible instructions
text:
Okay, but somewat cumbersome and horrible instructions. I wanted an electric, non-battery solution for a variety of reasons. This is highly-rated unit seemed to be a good choice.

First, the instructions cost it one full star. They have nothing but small, difficult to see pictograms that do not include several steps and are hard to follow. Whatever happened to words? Hope you have perfect eyesight and lots of insight into the unit! Otherwise, prepare to struggle.

The second problem is that the unit is cumbersome when used in suction mode. Use disposable bags, and it is even worse as the loop for a strap consistently breaks. Another lost star.

The unit has a nice ability to control the blower. Not much else makes it stand out, though.

I rate this unit as acceptable and am keeping it. I do not see it being near a 5 star unit, though.
